apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.2 — Waveform touch forwarding, third cut, driven by the hosting tests: the hit is now resolved through the window's own hit-testing (the path a real touch takes) with the scroll layer temporarily invisible, instead of descending into the wave container directly. The LoopLab editor push at the library stack root is unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
